summary: KLX Energy Services Holdings filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing that its board adopted a stockholder protection rights plan (poison pill) and declared a dividend of one right per outstanding common share, payable October 5, 2026, to holders of record. The rights detach upon any person or group acquiring 10% beneficial ownership without board approval, at which point the acquirer's rights become void and exercisable rights trigger significant dilution; an exchange feature applies above 20%. Shares trade on Nasdaq under KLXE, rights under KLXER. The defensive move signals perceived takeover or accumulation pressure, framing a risk-arb watch on any 13D filing or bid.
